title: Entering a result from a paper report
summary: Search for the person first, enter a faxed lab result on their record, and read what MERIT did with it.

steps.say: A faxed lab report has arrived for a child named Leo Rivera. Before entering anything, search for him, so the result joins his existing record.
Type the last name, then the first name. Adding the date of birth from the report narrows the search to one person.
One match, with the same name and date of birth. Open his record.
onScreen: Rivera, Leo Feb 2, 2021 Male Baltimore City Name

steps.say: The person page shows who he is and his history. Choose Enter a result.
onScreen: Leo Rivera · Enter a result · Edit identity · Child Born Feb 2, 2021 (age 5) · Male · County: Baltimore City · Preferred language: Spanish · Aliases, race and ethnicity, contact methods

steps.say: Choose the analyte first. The specimen and unit choices follow it.
The report says the blood was drawn from a vein, so set the sample type to venous.
Type the value exactly as reported: 4.2 µg/dL.
Enter the date the blood was collected, which is required, and the date the lab reported it.
Add the test method, the lab's accession number, and the reason for the test.
For the laboratory, type part of its name, then choose it from the list.
actions: Selects “Chesapeake Reference Laboratory 100 Research Drive, Columbia, CLIA 21D0712345”

steps.say: Check the entries against the paper report, then choose Save result.
MERIT confirms the result, with the value converted to its standard unit and the population it counts toward.
onScreen: Result saved · Lead 4.2 ug/dL → canonical 4.2000 ug/dL · population Child

steps.say: Below it, MERIT lists each level the result was compared with, and whether a case was opened or updated.
onScreen: Thresholds and case outcome · Opened confirmed case PB-2026-000024, owned by Maryland Lead and Metals Program (demo). · Level Type Value This result · Case Case 3.5 ug/dL At or above · Reportable Reportable 0 ug/dL At or above · Child: one venous result at or above the level, by a confirming method. · Tasks created: Investigate 1214 W Lombard Street 2F, Baltimore, MD; Investigate 27 Oak Avenue, To

steps.say: From here, enter another result from the same report, or go back to his record.
onScreen: Open the case Enter another result Back to the person
